steps.goal: Cut each avocado in half lengthwise, around the pit.
how: put the avocado flat on the board
push the knife in until it hits the pit
rotate the avocado all the way around the knife
twist the two halves apart
tips: keep the avocado on the board, never in your palm
hold it with fingers curled away from the blade (claw grip)
steps.done_when: avocado halves visible, cut faces up
steps.fallback: Cut the avocados in half lengthwise around the pit.

steps.goal: Get the pits out and scoop the flesh into the bowl.
how: scoop the pit out with a spoon (or ease it out with your fingers)
scoop the green flesh into the bowl
throw away the skins
tips: don't stab the pit with the knife while holding the avocado in your hand
ripe flesh should come away from the skin easily
steps.done_when: green flesh in bowl, empty skins
steps.fallback: Remove the pits and scoop the flesh into the bowl.

steps.goal: Mash the avocado, leaving it a bit chunky.
how: press down with the back of the fork
work around the bowl
stop while there are still small lumps
tips: chunky is better than smooth for guacamole
tilt the bowl so it doesn't slide
steps.fallback: Mash the avocado with a fork, leave it a bit chunky.

steps.goal: Finely dice about a quarter of an onion.
how: cut a quarter off the onion and peel it
slice it thinly one way, then across
rock the knife over the pieces to make them smaller
tips: claw grip: tuck your fingertips in and let the knife touch your knuckles
keep the flat side of the onion down so it doesn't roll
steps.fallback: Finely dice about a quarter of an onion.

steps.goal: Dice one tomato and add it to the bowl with the onion.
how: cut the tomato in half
scoop out the watery seeds if you like
cut it into small cubes
slide the tomato and onion into the bowl
tips: a sawing motion works better than pressing on soft tomato
claw grip again for the small cuts
steps.fallback: Dice one tomato and add it with the onion.

steps.goal: Squeeze in half a lime and add a pinch of salt.
how: cut the lime in half
squeeze one half over the bowl, catching the seeds
add a pinch of salt
tips: roll the lime on the board first to get more juice
you can add more salt at the end after tasting
steps.fallback: Squeeze in half a lime and add a pinch of salt.

steps.goal: Chop some cilantro, add it, and stir everything together.
how: bunch up a small handful of cilantro
chop it finely
add it to the bowl
stir everything together and taste
tips: the stems are fine to use, they have lots of flavour
taste and adjust with more lime or salt
steps.fallback: Chop some cilantro, add it, and stir everything together.
